name: Kobble's page
about: The page a product team uses on its own computer: Signals (what was learned), Explorations (a board and a conversation with the kobold, with live prototypes), Factory (the board the builder works) and Personas (the people the product is for, and their tests).

users.who: a small product team (an owner who is not a developer, and developers)
users.does: collect signals, explore them with the kobold, agree on prototypes and follow the builds
